_read_me: Copy this file to my-company/engine.json, then fill in the <...> parts. Never put real keys in this template or anywhere else in git. guide/engine-setup.md explains each field.
userAgent: LeadScout/0.1 (+contact via the address in each email)

sending._read_me: route: by_hand (recommended) writes each approved email to my-company/outbox for you to send from your own mailbox. practice is for trying it out. ses is optional and advanced: see guide/engine-setup.md Part 5 first.
sending.postalAddress: <your company's real postal address, one line: required before any email is approved>
sending.replyTo: <optional: where replies go, e.g. you@yourcompany.com; delete this line if not needed>
sending._ses_only: The lines below are only for the optional Amazon SES route.
sending.fromAddress: <SES only: you@your-sending-domain.com; delete if not using SES>
sending.awsRegion: <SES only: e.g. us-east-1; delete if not using SES>
sending.awsProfile: <SES only: e.g. lead-scout; delete if not using SES>
